comparison.objective: Reassign three round-bottom flasks among occupied rings without any flask touching the bench.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual rearrangement with temporary in-air holding because no destination is initially free.
comparison.success_condition: Flasks end in matching rings; any flask bottom within 3 mm of the table forces zero.
comparison.reason: Its defining ability is vacancy-free rearrangement with sustained holding, unrelated to impact finishing.
